title: Riglane Hook — Cursor subagentStop Input + Decision Output
description: Schemas for the Cursor subagentStop hook contract: the JSON payload Cursor sends via stdin, and the JSON decision the engine writes to stdout.

input.description: JSON payload Cursor delivers via stdin. Discriminators: cursor_version OR loop_count present.

cursor_version.description: Cursor version string. Presence implies Cursor host.

hook_event_name.description: Event name (e.g., 'subagentStop'). Cursor 2.6.19+ sends this — NOT a reliable host discriminator on its own.

status.description: Subagent termination status. Engine MUST process only status='completed'; other values MUST be skipped silently with stdout={}.

loop_count.description: Cursor-managed gate retry counter. 0 = first attempt; increments on each gate retry within the same subagent session. Engine MUST honor max_gate_retries against this value.

subagent_id.description: Cursor subagent identifier. Phantom filter: identifiers starting with 'toolu_' MUST be treated as orchestrator turns and skipped.

task.description: Composed task prompt sent to the subagent. Phantom filter: empty/whitespace-only task MUST be skipped. The orchestrator embeds <!--workflow:run_token:UUID--> and (for parallel) <!--workflow:branch:N--> markers in this field.

summary.description: Subagent's own summary of what it did.

agent_transcript_path.description: Path to subagent transcript (Cursor-provided when available).

model.description: LLM model used by the subagent.

message_count.description: Number of messages in the subagent session.

decision.description: JSON decision the engine writes to stdout. Empty object {} = pass (no retry). Non-empty followup_message = retry with the message shown to the subagent.

followup_message.description: Message shown to the subagent to guide a retry. When this field is present and non-empty, Cursor invokes the subagent again with this message; loop_count increments. When omitted or empty, the subagent stops normally.
